# google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile

A SAML federation between a Google enterprise customer and a SAML identity provider.

The caller must be a Google Workspace / Cloud Identity administrator of the
customer with the SSO settings privilege (for example a super admin);
Google Cloud IAM roles are not sufficient.

If you are using User ADCs (Application Default Credentials) with this resource,
you must specify a `billing_project` and set `user_project_override` to true
in the provider configuration. Otherwise the Cloud Identity API will return a 403 error.
Your account must have the `serviceusage.services.use` permission on the
`billing_project` you defined.


To get more information about InboundSamlSsoProfile, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/reference/rest/v1/inboundSamlSsoProfiles)
* How-to Guides
    * [Assign SSO profiles](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/how-to/assign-sso-profiles)
    * [Set up SSO with a third party IdP](https://support.google.com/a/answer/12032922)

~> **Warning:** If the customer has Multi-Party Approval (MPA) enabled for sensitive actions,
creating or updating a profile returns an error (`awaiting-multi-party-approval`) while
the change awaits second-admin approval in Google Admin Console. Once approved,
a newly created profile can be imported and an updated profile can be refreshed.


## Example Usage - Cloud Identity Inbound Saml Sso Profile Basic


```hcl
resource "google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile" "saml_profile" {
  customer     = "customers/A01b123xz"
  display_name = "saml-profile"

  idp_config {
    entity_id                  = "https://idp.example.com/saml-profile"
    single_sign_on_service_uri = "https://idp.example.com/sso"
    logout_redirect_uri        = "https://idp.example.com/logout"
    change_password_uri        = "https://idp.example.com/change-password"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `idp_config` -
  (Required)
  SAML identity provider configuration.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_idp_config).


* `customer` -
  (Optional)
  The customer. For example: `customers/C0123abc`. If omitted, the customer of the caller is used.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Human-readable name of the SAML SSO profile.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_idp_config"></a>The `idp_config` block supports:

* `entity_id` -
  (Required)
  The SAML **Entity ID** of the identity provider.

* `single_sign_on_service_uri` -
  (Required)
  The `SingleSignOnService` endpoint location (sign-in page URL) of the identity provider.
  This is the URL where the `AuthnRequest` will be sent. Must use `HTTPS`.
  Assumed to accept the `HTTP-Redirect` binding.

* `logout_redirect_uri` -
  (Optional)
  The **Logout Redirect URL** (sign-out page URL) of the identity provider. When a user
  clicks the sign-out link on a Google page, they will be redirected to this URL. This is
  a pure redirect with no attached SAML `LogoutRequest` i.e. SAML single logout is not
  supported. Must use `HTTPS`.

* `change_password_uri` -
  (Optional)
  The **Change Password URL** of the identity provider. Users will be sent to this URL
  when changing their passwords at `myaccount.google.com`. This takes precedence over
  the change password URL configured at customer-level. Must use `HTTPS`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}`

* `name` -
  Resource name of the SAML SSO profile, assigned by the server.
  Format: `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}`.

* `inbound_saml_sso_profile_id` -
  The server-assigned ID of the SAML SSO profile (the last segment of
  `name`).

* `sp_config` -
  SAML service provider configuration for this SAML SSO profile. These are the service
  provider details provided by Google that should be configured on the corresponding
  identity provider.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_sp_config).


<a name="nested_sp_config"></a>The `sp_config` block contains:

* `entity_id` -
  (Output)
  The SAML **Entity ID** for this service provider.

* `assertion_consumer_service_uri` -
  (Output)
  The SAML **Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL** to be used for the IDP-initiated
  login. Assumed to accept response messages via the `HTTP-POST` binding.

## Import


InboundSamlSsoProfile can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}`
* `{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import InboundSamlSsoProfile using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    inboundSamlSsoProfileId = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import InboundSamlSsoProfile using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}"
  to = google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), InboundSamlSsoProfile can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile.default inboundSamlSsoProfiles/{{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}
$ terraform import google_cloud_identity_inbound_saml_sso_profile.default {{inbound_saml_sso_profile_id}}
```
